tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Alternate near-black for large headings on surface; interchangeable with ink.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary/supporting text on surface and surface-alt (8.06:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page and card background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate neutral surface for cards/sections that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Soft alternate page background.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers/hairlines on surface (1.3:1) — not for required boundaries, focus rings or disabled states; use brand or a status color for those.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary brand color — primary buttons, links, active states. Reads 6.32:1 on surface; white text on brand reads 6.32:1.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand actions; a stronger heading tint (9.93:1 on surface).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Light tinted background for brand badges/highlights. ink on it reads 15.37:1; brand text on it reads 4.62:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Secondary interactive accent (alternate CTA / link-hover). White text on it reads 6.65:1.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Dark section background for marketing/hero and footer surfaces.

tokens.name: on-midnight
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on midnight (15.54:1).

tokens.name: on-midnight-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary/muted text on midnight ONLY (6.45:1) — fails on surface (2.55:1); never use on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-midnight-accent
tokens.usage: Large text (24px+), links or icon accents on midnight ONLY (4.05:1) — below the small-text floor, clears the large-text/UI floor; not for small body copy.

tokens.name: highlight-gold
tokens.usage: Sparing highlight/badge accent on midnight (9.80:1).

tokens.name: highlight-mauve
tokens.usage: Secondary sparing highlight accent on midnight (8.55:1).

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero/marketing headlines and the cover name.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy, set in ink on surface.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, labels and metadata, set in text-secondary.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact padding inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between related inline elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card/section padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page-level margins and large section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large surfaces, modals.
